name: order-matrix
title: Order matrix
description: Order a product by size and colour in one grid: a quantity field per cell, stock hints, row and column totals, and paste from a spreadsheet.
docs: rows are the variants (colours or widths, with an optional swatch) and columns the sizes. stock holds what can be ordered per row id and column id: a cell that is missing is not made in that size and is disabled (a dash), zero is sold out and says Sold out under the field, and a quantity is held to its stock and said so; with lowStockAt or fewer left a cell says how many. Control the quantities with value and onChange or leave them to defaultValue; a cell at zero is left out of the object. minPerCell flags a quantity above zero but below the minimum and keeps Add from being pressed. unitPrice (minor units) adds the money. onAddAll receives every line and the totals and may return a promise. Arrow keys and Enter move between cells, and pasting a block of numbers from a spreadsheet fills the grid from the cell you are in. A grid wider than its frame scrolls sideways, keeps its first column in view (the field the keyboard moves to is scrolled clear of that column) and says so under the grid. Every field is named Navy, size M; labels holds every word, including the name pattern. Always pass locale.
